parsed.main_gap: Tree-component argument omits the (one-line) justification that every piece inside the component's intervals is paired within that component, which is what makes the signed sum telescope into the x_{2j-1}-x_{2j} terms.

errors.description: In the refinement-lemma lower bound, the identity |Σ_U a_i − Σ_W a_i| = ±Σ(x_{2j-1}−x_{2j}) ± x_r needs the fact that any piece lying in an interval of the chosen component is paired with a piece in the same component (otherwise its edge would merge components). This is used but never stated, and it is exactly what rules out stray unmatched pieces contributing.
errors.quote: Expanding each \(a_i\) as the sum of its descendant final pieces, every paired edge in the chosen component contributes, up to sign, \(x_{2j-1}-x_{2j}\).

errors.description: Liu's marks are misstated: interval lengths δ,2δ,...,2^nδ correspond to marks at the partial sums (2^j−1)δ (i.e. δ,3δ,7δ,…), not at 2^jδ. The stated mark set would produce different interval lengths. Clearly a typo, since (9) fixes the strategy, but as written it is inconsistent.
errors.quote:
Thus his marks are \(2^j\delta\) for \(1\le j\le n\), all distinct and
strictly inside the stick.

parsed.notes: Answer 2^n/(2^{n+1}−1) verified independently for n=1. Drafting lemma, subset-gap pigeonhole, graph/tree lower bound and overlay upper bound are all essentially correct, including edge cases (loops, parity, B=∅, coincident cuts). Section 5 is irrelevant padding but harmless.
